name: mish.home
description: A terminal-style home page you open Obsidian to, the same in every vault and never scrolling: a big block-letter clock, the weather, a todo list, countdowns, a focus timer, system stats, shortcuts and a real little terminal with autosuggestions and tab completion. Notes-based sections (recent notes, streak grid, vault tasks) are optional. Every section is fully themeable. Desktop only.
author: mishti
